name: elysium-testnet-v2-factory
_why: Testnet redeploy (Nov 12) with the new testnet wallet, run the same way as mainnet: every value explicit, nothing copied from Cloak v1. Writes deployments/elysium-testnet-v2-factory.json over the old record.
_poolManager: Cloak's testnet deployment of Uniswap's exact v4 PoolManager build.
_owner: The testnet main wallet (owner, treasury and deployer roles on testnet only). It calls acceptOwnership() on the config after the deploy.
_vaultVerifier: Gloam's verifier on testnet (the one the testnet Gloam vault uses).
